messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up — prod link-check started failing after the redirect PR. Error: `Anchor not found: guide-auth referenced from /docs/auth/overview.html`.
Elena Park: Full log: ```Error: Could not find anchor #guide-auth in /docs/auth/overview.html at checkLinks (link-checker/index.js:101)```
Diego Cruz: We added a redirect from /docs/auth to /docs/auth/overview/ and also changed the heading 'Guide: Auth' -> 'Guide — Auth (OIDC)'. That probably changed the slug. Redirects don't rewrite anchors.
Zoe Kim: Right. The redirect means old URLs hit the new page but the fragment (#guide-auth) needs to match a heading id on the target. If slug changed, the fragment 404s. Two fixes: add explicit {#guide-auth} to the heading, or add client-side JS to map old fragments to new ones. Prefer static fix in docs.
Elena Park: Also saw encoded characters in the bad fragments: one link contained `%E2%80%94` which is an em-dash. That came from the long dash in the heading. We should normalize or pin ids.
Diego Cruz: I'm going to open a PR to: 1) add explicit ids for the top-level anchors affected by redirects, 2) update the redirect rules in _redirects to include fragment mappings where feasible, and 3) add a link-check CI step that resolves redirects and validates fragments post-redirect.
Zoe Kim: Nice. Also add a short note in the migration guide: "If you change a heading that is targeted by redirects, add an explicit `{#id}` so previous links keep working." New contributors often overlook redirect+anchor combos.
link-bot: label added: docs-review. reviewers requested: Elena Park, Zoe Kim.
Elena Park: Quick review notes: LGTM, please remove a stray trailing space on the mdx id line. Also include one example of fixing a redirect+fragment pair in the PR description.
Diego Cruz: Done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1189 — adds explicit ids to the redirected pages, updates the redirect rules, and includes a post-redirect fragment check in CI using a headless browser to follow redirects and assert fragments resolve.
ci-bot: running docs CI for PR 1189...
ci-bot: ✔ build succeeded, ✔ post-redirect fragment-check passed.
link-bot: PR #1189 merged by Diego Cruz.
Elena Park: Verified staging: following old redirect URLs with fragments now lands at the right section. Spot-checked common links in the migration guide.
Zoe Kim: Filed follow-up issue to add a small JS fallback mapping for legacy fragments we can't modify: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/256.
Diego Cruz: Closing thread. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
